messages:
Rohit (Finance): Heads-up: MedAtlas flagged their annual true-up invoice TU-2026-0912 — they're disputing platform seat charges for a cluster we show active Mar 28-31. They claim nodes were in 'onboarding' and waived per SOW.

Sasha (AE): MedAtlas signed SOW with onboarding waiver for first 30 days of a cluster, yes. They spun up 6 nodes on Mar 28 and said onboarding ends Apr 27. Why are we billing Mar pro rata for 4 days?

Janelle (Billing Ops): Billing export shows true-up calculation counts any active node during the month as a full prorated month. For TU-2026-0912 we billed 6 nodes * prorated days (4/31) and treated the waiver as a credit only if cluster label = ONBOARDING in contract snapshot. Their cluster was labeled temp_onboard in infra, so contract matcher missed it.

Omar (Solutions Eng): Confirmed: orchestration used label temp_onboard during quick deploy. Ops policy changed labels last quarter and we didn't update the contract matching rules.

Rohit (Finance): Customer asks for reversal of the March seat prorate (~$2,400) and a corrected true-up. Propose issuing credit and fixing matcher. Need legal sign-off on waiver semantics.

Tara (Legal): SOW clause 4.2 grants onboarding waiver for "initial deployment" when Customer notifies within 10 days. Need to confirm MedAtlas filed onboarding request (ticket CHG-504). If they did, waiver applies. If not, we can offer a one-time concession to preserve relationship.

Janelle (Billing Ops): Found ticket CHG-504 created Mar 29 by MedAtlas CS rep. That satisfies notification. We can void TU-2026-0912 and re-run true-up excluding waived days. ETA 1 business day after approval.

Rohit (Finance): OK approve reversal $2,400 credit and reissue corrected true-up. Also open BF-2001 to extend label matcher to include historical aliases (temp_onboard). Janelle please attach internal memo INTCORR-321 documenting concession.

billing-bot: Created ticket TKT-8724 linking TU-2026-0912; credit memo CM-2026-099 created for $2,400; engineering branch billing/fix/onboard-labels-2001 created.

Sasha (AE): I'll notify MedAtlas that we found the onboarding ticket and will apply the credit + corrected true-up. Will send copy of the customer note here.

Tara (Legal): Approve wording. Add line: "This credit is issued consistent with SOW section 4.2 and does not waive other contract terms."

Rohit (Finance): Thanks team. Janelle — confirm when the corrected invoice is sent so I can close the AR case.

Janelle (Billing Ops): Will update here after reissue. BF-2001 added to backlog for priority patch.

Sasha (AE): Sent to customer: "We've applied a $2,400 credit for onboarding days in March and reissued the true-up. Sorry for the confusion — thank you for flagging."

Rohit (Finance): Closing loop: credit applied and corrected true-up issued. Logged remediation and legal note in contract folder.

Sasha (AE): Great — MedAtlas replied :thumbsup:.
